purpose: Qualify the current complete compiler workload; ordinary current-main MLF/GHC timing and separate diagnostic profile. No compiler optimization effect or native fixed-point A/B.
primary_endpoint: Source through runnable compiler including link. GHC-built ordinary O2 MLF vs GHC9.14.1 O2 -j1 on the same frozen 90 shared modules. Original five-line GHC Main wrapper and fixed host adapters are explicitly accounted for.
following_comparison: Only after both endpoints qualify, use the existing fixed MLF/GHC/GHC/MLF four-run controller with the first accepted main checked output as frozen reference. Do not replace, extend or pool samples.
diagnostics: A separate MLF_QUERY_PROFILE=1 fresh checked run may follow, always outside ordinary timing. Compare checked artifact bytes and ordered groups with ordinary main reference before interpreting its phases.
freshness: No target query or object reuse. Fresh output directories and complete independently reconstructed import closure per leg. Fixed builtin, primitive/host, runtime and installed GHC dependencies may be reused.
failure_rule: Record any timeout/resource/correctness failure and stop that comparison. Do not silently raise caps, skip work, remove failed observations or retry an uncertain outcome. Qualification-only tool defects are retained and corrected with a new output identity before timing.
